notes.title: Patch notes - Version 0.2.4
notes.content:
New Tiles!!
Here's the list of changes in this new build of the demo:

New tiles available! 

A brand new Charm of Magnetism!

Added some brand new sounds for the inventory.

Fixed a known bug in which the effect of the poison from the quark-charm enemy kept going even after a restart of the run.

Fixed a bug where, if you bought an item from the shop and died, if you won the "wave" gameplay the items wasn't brought along.

Added some quality of life improvements, like the settings panel that now is accessible from the starting menu and the "mana" bar that now is specifically tied to a weapon and has an overload system.

Temporarily removed the Orbital Accumulator from the pool of weapons while we work on the design and clarity of the weapon.

Added the possibility to skip the starting cinematic alltoghether.

Fixed a bug where the music tracks stacked with each other.

Minor bugfix. 

Thanks for the feedbacks! We're greatful for the help and we hope to get back to you with the best product possible!

Also in this patch, if you play the demo and don't wishlist the game you'll be doomed for life, but that's just a minor thing ;) Have a good one <3

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo
notes.content:
Ciao Everyone!
This is the list of changes in the new build of the demo.

Integrated GAME SAVES (yay!!). Now you can save the game and close it and you'll start from where you left the next time you want to play!

Fixed a known issue where the viewfinder of some weapons didn't work after respawning.

Fixed a bug that kept the green poison shader from the Charm Enemy if you died while being poisoned.

Thanks a lot for the feedback, you guys are fundamental for the developing process!



Now go test the latest version and let us know what you think! <3

notes.title: Demo is out now!!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the first demo of MassEve is out and playable!
In this demo, you will dive into the very first of the biomes we conceptualized: the Photons Reign.

Please go check it out, and if you can leave a review!

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to ask away in the comments of this post and we'll use this page and our socials to answer them best we can. Feedback is more valuable than gold during the production of a videogame.

Thanks for your support, we hope you like it ❤️
